expected.subject: Recurring on Growth?
expected.body: There's no 'Make recurring' option under More. Why?

tickets.reply:
Hi there,

The 'Make recurring' option only appears on the Pro plan — recurring invoices aren't included in Growth.

If you'd like to use them, you can upgrade:
1. Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan.
2. Choose Pro (R699/month).

Upgrades take effect immediately, and you're charged a pro-rated amount for the rest of the current month. Once you're on Pro, open any invoice and click More > Make recurring to set the frequency and start date.

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.
